leaves.name: passive-event-device-port
leaves.implementation: Device/Event records stream labels and asserts queries/elapsed reads happen only during emit. Constant0.25ms is a receipt plumbing sentinel, never a GPU timing measurement. Event allocation can raise OSError, endpoints can remain pending, caps are exercised. Real operation sampling and old fused_refusal execute.
leaves.equivalence: Event count, deferred query/read, caps, incomplete/cancel behavior and exact context reset execute real recorder code. CPU sentinel values only test accounting.
leaves.cannot_prove: CUDA event allocation bytes, driver overhead or device timing/numerics.

leaves.name: real-indexer-host-cpu-kernel-ports
leaves.replaces: _qsa_mqa_paged_prefill_kernel and torch.ops._C topk CUDA kernels via test_n3_indexer_lifetime.Ports
leaves.implementation: Actual fully pinned generated indexer host functions, real CPU BF16/FP32 tensors and numerical mm/topk ports. ContextVar is the same native_measurement.INDEXER_PHASE_CONTEXT scoped by the driver. Compare all outputs/score bytes/launch geometry and the one-live-score invariant; no GPU initialized.
leaves.equivalence: Observational hooks do not change numerical operands or order. Actual GPU kernels remain unchanged by AST, but CPU ports do not certify GPU numerical equality.
leaves.cannot_prove: Actual CUDA numerical results, concurrent streams or GPU allocator headroom.

leaves.name: real-four-worker-fused-composition
leaves.replaces: Existing test_e3_native_qsa_fused.FusedNetwork and its declared step_a/submission-credit device/model/TP/PP leaves
leaves.implementation: Real controller, NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, QsaLayerDriver, QsaPrefillOperation and generated dense staged attention; three buckets. CUDA timing events extend the existing FakeSparseDevice with labeled FakeEvents. Stage1 has the existing NoQsaDriver. Indexer remains its original kernel leaf and deliberately emits NO score/topk markers, so phase receipts must be INCOMPLETE rather than forged complete.
leaves.equivalence: Same fused command list, copy spans, waits, output plumbing and released source holds off/on; all work can enqueue with no ready device events or host readback. Late release/phase sink exceptions or False returns do not quarantine or strand owners.
leaves.cannot_prove: Actual device timing/values, TP/PP kernels or GPU memory. Separate actual-indexer-host proof exercises score/topk markers.

leaves.name: atomic-receipt-writer-reader
leaves.replaces: os.write with existing test_alpha_next_receipts.capture_writer capture on a real pipe fd
leaves.implementation: Real ReceiptWriter, same new JSON prefix, record identity, byte budget and receipt_lines integrity check. Nested emit_receipt_lines interception in other tests captures formatted rows; failure paths raise OSError or return False explicitly.
leaves.equivalence: End-to-end serializer/prefix/integrity behavior and3968-byte bound execute. Capture avoids writing a log file as engine output.
leaves.cannot_prove: Box pipe pressure or actual log-reader throughput.
